verdict.rationale: Datalab's quickstart says you can upload a document to Forge, its in-app playground at /app/playground, and "see results instantly — no API key required" before writing code. The changelog shows the playground also previews Track Changes extraction results directly in the UI. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that schema-based structured extraction (not just parsing/track changes) runs in the playground, documented drag-and-drop interaction, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground experience.
